digest.headline: UK broadband growth stalls as Paramount considers California exit
digest.lead: The UK fixed broadband market has recorded its flattest quarter ever, while Sky Sports and Disney plus secured major broadcasting rights. Meanwhile, Paramount is considering moving its studio out of California as legal battles over the Warner Bros Discovery merger intensify.

glance.text: Sky Sports has secured the exclusive UK and Ireland broadcast rights for the 2026 Laver Cup tennis tournament.
Media regulator Ofcom is investigating GB News after a guest made highly controversial comments linking pride parades to paedophilia.
Samsung TV Plus has expanded its UK free ad-supported streaming offering with new channels from PA Media and All3Media.
Nation Radio London breached broadcasting rules by airing a prohibited political advertisement despite receiving clearance from Radiocentre.
Disney+ has acquired the global streaming rights to the Formula E electric vehicle motor racing championship in 144 territories.
Paramount CEO David Ellison is considering moving the studio out of California due to a legal fight over the Warner Bros merger.
The CRTC is considering a proposal to remove expiry dates for television broadcast licences held by companies like Bell and Rogers.

paragraphs: Sky Sports has agreed a deal with Trident8 to broadcast all three days of the 2026 Laver Cup from London's O2 Arena [27, 38]. The men's team tennis tournament will feature top players including Carlos Alcaraz and Alexander Zverev [2].

Disney+ has secured a multi-year deal for global streaming rights to the Formula E motor racing championship [22, 37]. The platform will stream the electric vehicle races in 144 territories starting from the 2026/27 season [22, 37].

Samsung TV Plus has expanded its UK FAST channel portfolio [21, 51]. It partnered with PA Media to launch the 24-hour channel Your Sports News, and added four single-programme channels from All3Media International [21, 46, 51].
